name: Fukushuu Shite Yaru! ~Murder Princess Nahtigarh~
original_name: 復讐してやる！ ～マーダープリンセス・ナハティガル～
source:
The pleasure city of Beverkut, surrounded by high, solid walls, fulfills human desires, including commerce and pleasure. 

Where people's desires gather, money also tends to gather, and so does the ambition to rule it.

In addition to the lord who rules the city of Beverkut, there is a group called "The Organization" that tries to control the city from behind the scenes. 

Hatty is a woman who is called the "Murder Princess" and is on The Organization's assassination team. She was only good at killing, but she betrayed the organization and was executed. 

When Hatty, who was supposed to have been killed, wakes up again, she finds herself in a laboratory and has been resurrected. With a desire for revenge against the organization in her heart, Hatty throws herself into the fight against the organization.

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro-touch/work/=/product_id/VJ013266.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
高耸坚固的城墙环绕着享乐之都贝弗库特。这里的商业与娱乐，满足着人们形形色色的欲望。

欲望汇聚之处，金钱也会随之聚集，而支配这一切的野心同样如此。

除了统治贝弗库特的领主，还有一个被称为“组织”的团体，试图从幕后掌控这座城市。

哈蒂是“组织”暗杀部队中的一名女性，拥有“杀戮公主”的称号。她唯一擅长的便是杀人，却因背叛组织而遭到处决。

本应死去的哈蒂再次醒来时，发现自己身在实验室中，已经被人复活。怀着对组织的复仇之心，她投身于与组织的战斗。
